title: All for the Show - Major Sponsor

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All for the Show - Major Sponsor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Lately, grenades haven't been flying well: newbies don't know how to use them and just ignore them. It frustrates me and the supplier of this stuff, and he's a major sponsor! We need to fix this, fast. Show the other fighters what advantage they're missing. Make those weaklings start training with grenades so they don't fall behind!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 5 enemies in one life 10 times
- Eliminate 2 or more enemies with headshots within one round 10 times

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +20,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.05
- 250,000 Roubles
- 100 GP coins
- Unlocks Splinter Stripe Yellow weapon camouflage
